newsitem.title: CHINA: Shenzhen SEG first half net 81.07 mln.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen SEG first half net 81.07 mln.

text.p: China's Shenzhen SEG Co Ltd posted net profits of 81.07 million yuan on revenue of 869.57 million for the first half of 1997, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said on Tuesday.
The company's per-share net was 0.201 yuan and net asset per share was 2.564 yuan on a fully diluted basis, the exchange said in a notice issued after the market closed.
It did not say whether the results reflected Chinese or international accounting standards and gave no comparative figures.
In the first half of 1996, SEG booked unaudited net profits of 60.17 million yuan.
Trading in the company's stocks would be suspended on Wednesday morning for the results announcement and would resume in the afternoon, the notice said.
